_doc: Visual specification as data. design/ART_SPEC.md explains each value; tests/unit/render checks they hold.

projection._doc: Square logical tiles seen from 45 degrees of yaw and `elevation_deg` above the horizon.

layers._doc: Draw order, back to front. Entities inside `world_entities` are y-sorted by their origin pivot.

day_cycle._doc: Colour keyframes over one day (t = fraction of the day, 0 = morning). The sea and the world light are interpolated between neighbouring keys; t=1 meets t=0. Step 56: there is no sky -- sea is [far, mid, deep, shallow], far being the light the water reflects (the top of the screen leans towards it); the sun and moon are only a faint glow on the water, placed by their arcs (the sun's wraps past midnight: it rises before the day rolls over).

evolution._doc: A pennant on the four building families once their mastery reaches each level: bronze, silver, gold.

island_tiers._doc: Step 63: a City's island looks grown up. From tier `city_from_tier` (City, and so Nation too) the grass is tinted `city_grass_tint` (multiplied into the grass texture: a little warmer and richer) and the cliffs give way to a bank -- a soft slope from the land's height down to the waterline, `bank_run` tiles out into the water from every coast (half a tile, in logical x/y), shaped by distance to the land so corners, coves and inlets never overlap. `bank_steps` sub-quads a tile side; `bank_colors` [colour, distance as a share of the run] from the grass down to the wet sand at the waterline; the island's own grass texture runs on down the slope over them, fading out by `bank_grass_until` of the run, so the turf does not stop at the edge; past `bank_fade_from` the bank fades into the sea, where the ocean draws its foam line. `fade_seconds`: the change on promotion. A Village (and every island after a sale) keeps the cliffs. Visual only: cells, ownership, taps and the ground stay where they were. Step 73: each tier has a look of its own -- `city` and `nation` below (a Village is drawn as it always was). `lawn`: how the turf is mown, a brightness `amp` in rows (stripes) or a checker; `path`: a band `width` (tiles) inside every coast edge, its colour and, for a stone path, `joint` lines every `joint_every` tiles and a light `coping` line along the coast (the top of the wall); `beds`: what grows on a free cell (flowerbeds and hedges, or topiary); `lamps`: a lamp every other coast edge; `grass_tint` and `bank_colors` override the City's (a Nation's bank is stone in courses). On promotion the old look fades into the new one (`fade_seconds`). Only drawn: no cell, tap, path or building moves.

momo_depth._doc: Step 55: how much nearer than its feet a Momo counts when the island is depth-sorted (tiles of depth, x + y). Buildings stand at their footprint's centre, so a Momo on a building's own tile or beside its front half was drawn behind it -- the owner saw Momo vanish into buildings on ordinary walks. With 0.5 a Momo is drawn in front of a building unless it stands in the back quarter of its tile or on a tile behind it: clearly behind, it stays hidden. Only the order changes -- the Momo is drawn, tapped and dropped where it stands. Momo among themselves keep their order (every Momo gets the same bias).

night_lights._doc: Warm window light at night: strength follows how dark the ambient is (1 - its brightness); colour before the night tint.
